journey.name: Jade Wrong PIN
journey.description: Enters a wrong PIN on the Jade emulator's own PIN pad and checks the Found step's message. Requires `JADE_MODE=interactive ./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker`, a regtest debug build with the Jade emulator enabled (see the README) and no Jade paired. The emulator shows its PIN pad and waits for buttons; `./scripts/jade-emulator pin` enters a PIN.

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app and go to the wallet home screen
Open the menu (testTag "HeaderMenu"), tap Settings (testTag "DrawerSettings"), tap "Hardware Wallets" (testTag "HardwareWalletsSettings") and tap "Add Hardware Wallet" (testTag "AddHardwareWallet")
Tap "Continue" (testTag "HardwareWalletIntroContinue") and verify the "Found Device" step (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundScreen") headed "Found Jade" appears within 15 seconds
Tap "Connect" (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundConnect") and verify the hint "Enter your PIN on your Jade to unlock it." (testTag "HwFoundUnlockHint") shows
Run `./scripts/jade-emulator pin 999999` in `bitkit-docker` and verify that within 30 seconds the Found step shows "Wrong PIN. Try again on your Jade." (testTag "HwFoundError")

Tap "Connect" again, run `./scripts/jade-emulator pin 012345` (it first presses Continue on the device's "Incorrect PIN!" screen), and verify the "Device Connected" step (testTag "HardwareWalletPairedScreen") headed "Paired Jade" appears within 30 seconds
